title: Kubernetes Resource Management: Requests, Limits, and CFS Bandwidth Throttling
coreConcept: How the Linux Completely Fair Scheduler (CFS) throttles container CPU when quota limits are reached, and tuning cpu.cfs_quota_us.
codeSnippet:
resources:
  requests:
    memory: "2Gi"
    cpu: "1000m"
  limits:
    memory: "4Gi"
    # Best practice: Avoid hard CPU limits in latency-sensitive services to prevent CFS throttling

title: GitOps with ArgoCD and Helm: Automated Reconciliation and Drift Detection
coreConcept: Declarative multi-cluster deployment models, self-healing sync policies, and managing secret encryption via Sealed Secrets or SOPS.
codeSnippet:
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata: { name: "backend-api" }
spec:
  syncPolicy:
    automated: { prune: true, selfHeal: true }
  source:
    repoURL: "https://github.dataradix.in/gitops-deployments.git"
    targetRevision: HEAD
    path: apps/backend

title: Zero-Downtime Deployments: Blue-Green vs. Canary with Flagger and Prometheus Metrics
coreConcept: Automating progressive traffic shifting (10% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%) and rolling back automatically if error rates exceed 0.1% or latency surges.
codeSnippet:
apiVersion: flagger.app/v1beta1
kind: Canary
metadata: { name: backend-service }
spec:
  analysis:
    interval: 1m
    threshold: 3
    stepWeight: 10
    metrics:
    - name: request-success-rate
      thresholdRange: { min: 99 }

title: Docker Multi-Stage Builds: Optimizing JVM and Go Container Images for Minimal CVEs
coreConcept: Using Distroless or Alpine runtime images, removing compilers and package managers, and minimizing final image layers below 50MB.
codeSnippet:
# Stage 1: Build
FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jdk-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /build
COPY . .
RUN ./gradlew bootJar --no-daemon

# Stage 2: Distroless Runtime
FROM gcr.io/distroless/java21-debian12
COPY --from=builder /build/build/libs/app.jar /app.jar
CMD ["/app.jar"]

title: Observability with Prometheus and Grafana: Designing High-Cardinality Alerting Rules
coreConcept: Avoiding time-series explosion by omitting unbounded user/IP labels and constructing robust quantile queries (histogram_quantile).
codeSnippet:
# PromQL: 99th percentile HTTP latency over 5 minutes
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, service))

title: Cloud FinOps: Slashing AWS EMR and Kubernetes Spend with Karpenter and Spot Instances
coreConcept: Replacing cluster autoscaler with Karpenter for sub-minute EC2 provisioning, instance consolidation, and graceful 2-minute spot termination handling.
codeSnippet:
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1beta1
kind: NodePool
metadata: { name: spot-compute }
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      requirements:
      - key: karpenter.sh/capacity-type
        operator: In
        values: ["spot"]
      - key: node.kubernetes.io/instance-type
        operator: In
        values: ["m6i.2xlarge", "m6a.2xlarge", "c6i.2xlarge"]

title: Kubernetes Pod Disruption Budgets (PDB) and High Availability Scheduling
coreConcept: Guaranteeing minimum available pod replicas during node draining, kernel upgrades, and cluster auto-scaling operations.
codeSnippet:
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata: { name: api-pdb }
spec:
  minAvailable: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels: { app: api }

title: Securing CI/CD Pipelines: OpenID Connect (OIDC) Authentication with AWS and GitHub Actions
coreConcept: Eliminating long-lived AWS IAM access keys in GitHub Secrets by exchanging short-lived JWT OIDC tokens directly with AWS STS.

title: Securing Container Supply Chains with Sigstore Cosign and SLSA Provenance
